description: Enhance PdfPageManager with four linked improvements: (1) CSS-rotate thumbnails to reflect applied turns, (2) range-select input using parsePageSelection, (3) lightbox modal to inspect a page at larger size with quick actions, (4) auto-rebuild preview after operations when page count <= 20.
steps: STEP 1 — Visually rotate thumbnails. In the tag inside PdfPageManager.tsx (around line 420), add style={{ transform: `rotate(${slot.turn}deg)`, transition: 'transform 0.2s' }} so each thumbnail image rotates with the slot's turn value. The wrapping has overflow-hidden so rotated corners are clipped cleanly.

STEP 2 — Range selection input. Import parsePageSelection from '../tools/pdf'. Add a useState<string> for rangeInput (default ''). Render a text input next to the 'Select all' button in the toolbar (the flex-wrap row around line 350) with placeholder '1-3, 7' and value={rangeInput}. On change: call parsePageSelection(value, pages); if error is null, map the returned zero-based indices back to slot IDs (book.slots[index].id) and call setSelected with that Set; if error is non-null, show nothing or leave selection unchanged until input clears. Add a small 'x' clear button next to the input. The input should be styled consistently with the existing smallButton: a small border border-line bg-sunk text-xs text-ink placeholder-faint, about w-24 or w-28 wide.
STEP 3 — Lightbox modal. Add useState for lightboxId (the slot ID to show enlarged, null = closed). Add a double-click handler (onDoubleClick) on each page card's inner

STEP 4 — Auto-preview after operations. After turnSelected, duplicateSelected, and deleteSelected update the book state, check if book.slots.length <= 20 (use the slot count AFTER the update). Because React setState is async, calculate the new slot count before calling setBook and check that. If new count <= 20, call void saveTo('preview') after the state update in a useEffect that watches book.slots and runs only when a flag is set, OR: simpler approach: add a useRef<boolean> autoPreviewPending and after the setBook call in turnSelected/duplicateSelected/deleteSelected (when slots <= 20), set autoPreviewPending.current = true. Then in a separate useEffect that watches book.slots, if autoPreviewPending.current is true, reset it and call void saveTo('preview'). Show a note near the preview section: when busy === 'save' and pages <= 20, display a small 'Rebuilding preview…' text. The deleteSelected function needs to check slots.length after removal before deciding; pass the computed future length.
STEP 5 — Build and lint. Run npm run build and npm run lint. Fix any type errors or lint warnings introduced by the changes.
acceptance_criteria: Rotating a page (via toolbar or card ↻ button) immediately shows the thumbnail image rotated visually by the applied degrees, with no page reload.

Typing '1-3' in the range input selects the first three pages (highlighted with the accent ring). Typing an invalid value (e.g., '99' when there are 5 pages) does not crash, and the selection stays as it was.

Double-clicking a page card opens a lightbox overlay showing that page's thumbnail at a larger size with its page number, rotation, and Rotate left / Rotate right / Delete buttons. Pressing Escape or clicking outside the panel closes it.

After rotating or deleting pages when there are 20 or fewer pages total, the full-PDF preview is automatically rebuilt and shown below (the existing PdfPreview iframe updates). When there are more than 20 pages, the manual Preview button still works as before.
npm run build passes with no type errors.
npm run lint passes with no warnings.
findings: Build and lint pass cleanly (0 errors, 0 warnings). All 174 unit tests pass. Two lint warnings encountered during development were resolved: (1) ref mutation during render fixed by switching to useLayoutEffect; (2) setState-in-effect for lightbox cleanup fixed by relying on the existing render-time guard (lightboxId !== null && lbSlot !== undefined) instead of an effect. Review (2026-11-25) found four issues, all fixed: (1) lightbox rotate handlers now set autoPreviewPending.current = true when slots <= 20; (2) toggle() and selectAll() now clear rangeInput and rangeError so the field never shows a stale value after a manual card click; (3) lightbox image at 90/270 degrees now uses a wrapper div with swapped max-h/max-w constraints so the rotated image stays within viewport bounds; (4) handleRangeChange now sets rangeError from result.error and renders an inline red label below the range input.
